cases.expected: Burst не создаёт бесконечные UI/tasks/фото queues и не теряет edit/delete/auth/TTL; foreground B остаётся отзывчивым.
cases.evidence: At app-source commit e89265c0dda7dc88a7d7a7f75abd5010c25a48c9, TDLibUpdateBuffer adds a hard-bounded overflow reserve: at most one event for each of 20 client lanes, one unrouteable lane, and additional reserved bytes capped at 25% of the primary byte budget. A later audit found that one event larger than byteCapacity could still enter an otherwise empty queue. Fix 6c6fff49d6c43746b3990de178b723d1eaf75172 rejects oversized queue events and closes the receive gateway with an explicit error; the C bridge checks a 16 MiB maximum before copying TDLib's borrowed buffer. Added regression tests cover rejection while empty and fail-closed/send rejection. The exact-source local suite passed 136/136; macOS CI 38395900507 and pinned TDLib/Dev.app workflow 38395900428 succeeded on the same SHA. Instruments, real 20-account burst, queue/task/RSS behavior under load, and native foreground responsiveness remain unverified; acceptance stays partial.

cases.name: Identity/name/API
cases.expected: Own app id, repo owner, namespaces, public title, basic/sponsored compatibility verified.
cases.evidence: Historical identity/name evidence has been superseded by the user's later direction that the product name is NeTelegram; a quick web collision search is not trademark clearance. Telegram API Terms §1.3/1.4 base-functionality review is not complete. The local candidate adds text/photo sponsored cards and reporting, and now sends TDLib viewMessages for supported sponsored cards only after the complete text block is in the viewport. The pinned TDLib schema has no dedicated viewSponsoredMessage function; viewMessages is the supported abstraction and its pinned implementation forwards the sponsored view call. Sponsored animation/video handling, Telegram deep-link routing, and mandatory sponsored-video playback/timing remain incomplete. The user declined a scoped sponsored-video player and authorized deferring channel access or stable release. Channel support and stable compatibility are therefore release-blocked. No Telegram compatibility or stable-release pass is claimed. Official references: https://core.telegram.org/api/terms, https://core.telegram.org/api/sponsored-messages, pinned TDLib schema and SponsoredMessageManager.cpp at c15d3f5a5de6e3ba5839822c451152e5e18bb700. On 2026-10-14, rechecked the primary current Terms page and the exact pinned TDLib v1.8.68 schema at c15d3f5a5de6e3ba5839822c451152e5e18bb700. Terms §2.2 requires a prominent statement that the app uses Telegram API and is part of the Telegram ecosystem; the auth intro now states both ecosystem membership and API/TDLib use while retaining the no-affiliation disclosure. Terms §2.3 still conflicts with the requested exact public title NeTelegram. The pinned TDLib schema supports sponsored channel message, video media, and timed video-message advertisements (`getChatSponsoredMessages`, `getVideoMessageAdvertisements`, view/click/report methods); because the user declined a video player, channel access/stable release remains deferred.
